acquisition method: MS/MS analysis was programmed for a full scan recorded between m/z 400–1600 and an MS/MS scan to generate product ion spectra to determine amino acid sequence in consecutive scans starting from the most abundant peaks in the spectrum, and then selecting the next nine most abundant peaks.
alkylation reagent: dithiothreitol and iodoacetamide were sequentially added
cleavage agent: sequencing grade trypsin (Promega Corp., Madison, WI, United States) was added for digestion
instrument: nano-liquid chromatography-nanospray tandem mass spectrometry (LC/MS/MS) on a Thermo Scientific Q Exactive mass spectrometer
ionization type: nano-liquid chromatography-nanospray tandem mass spectrometry (LC/MS/MS) on a Thermo Scientific Q Exactive mass spectrometer equipped with an EASY-SprayTM Sources
labeling: Proteomics data were summarized in Scaffold 4.9.0 (Proteome Software Inc., Portland, OR, United States) for spectral counting analysis.
reduction reagent: dithiothreitol and iodoacetamide were sequentially added
